label: Rewarded D1 late in the episode (episode clock x reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass) and almost only when the reward input is 1 (99% of mass; essentially never on unrewarded D1, GO, or D2). Among rewarded D1 steps it is gated by an episode-time clock: the rate is about 1.4% for trials 0-69 and rises to 15% at trials 80-89 and 23% at 90-99 (trials 90-99 hold 67% of mass). Magnitude grows toward the end of the episode, with the top windows at ep_trial ~99. It also tracks the model value head being low (value < 5.22 holds 70% of mass), which is consistent with less remaining return late in the episode. value < 6 works about as well as ep_trial (F1 0.75), and an OR of the two adds nothing. Lower-magnitude activations occur on rewarded D1 earlier in the episode, often after a run of rewards, and these are missed. Many rewarded D1 steps late in long common-rewarded streaks stay silent. Only observed variables are used: the reward input and trial count are visible to the agent.
